observations.body: Peter addresses about one hundred twenty people, reads Judas’s absence through Scripture, sets witness criteria, and the gathered group prays and casts lots before Matthias is numbered with the Eleven.
observations.label: Matthias is numbered with the Eleven before the day arrives

observations.body: The passage presents Interpreting, nominating, praying, casting, and numbering as the scene's observable response or movement.

observations.body: The passage places Peter, Judas, Joseph, and Matthias beside Interpreting, nominating, praying, casting, and numbering.

payload.posture: Read Acts 1:15–26 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states peter addresses about one hundred twenty people, reads Judas’s absence through Scripture, sets witness criteria, and the gathered group prays and casts lots before Matthias is numbered with the Eleven. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Matthias is numbered with the Eleven before the day arrives
